notes.title: DD Editor 1.6.0
notes.content:
New Features:

 - Added the function of importing YOUTUBE links
 - BPM can now include decimals


Fixes:

 - Optimized FPS during playback (applicable to songs created in the new version)
 - The adjustment range for offset has been changed to -1.0 to +1.0
 - Fixed spelling errors in mod.io
 - Fixed an error where too many obstacle settings caused the scroll wheel to be unusable
 - Fixed an error where some obstacles were not correctly loaded during reading
 - Fixed a text description error in the sound effect function
 - Fixed an error where the song preview clip could not be modified
 - Fixed an issue where some songs could not be selected for update when uploading to MOD.io


Known Issues:

 - Negative offset will cut the music along with it
 - When re-entering the info interface, the sound of the song preview will play from the beginning of the song
 - Repeatedly importing the same album folder may cause display errors, and you need to delete the album folder to return to normal
